title: The Tulsa race riot and his mother's worry
summary: Fields explains that he went to Tulsa after the big riot, either 1917 or 1918 by his guess, and his mother worried.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: At first we had a big discussion about going up there and now you've got to be careful, that was just after the riot. They had this big riot in Tulsa, and so after talking to my brother, you know that's all over anyway, you can't stop, the world is going on anyway. That's just one of those things, it might happen if you're there or if you're not.
Are you referring to the big race riot?
Yes, I went afterwards, and of course my mother thought about that and was one of them, well actually I should not even be away from home.
